Composition references

Arrangement study: Ableton Learning Music, covering beats, chords, basslines, melody and structure. Timing and velocity study: Ableton Using Grooves. These are technique references; the app uses original note sequences and synthesized instruments, with no sampled songs.

Regular meters use sixteenth subdivisions; the jig groups 12 subdivisions into two dotted-quarter beats; the seven-legged dance groups 14 into 2+2+3 eighths. Swing moves every second eighth from the midpoint to two thirds of a quarter. Scan 7 plays four 4/4 bars at approximately 143 BPM; Scan 14 halves the tempo. Meter changes alter beat counts, so a waltz has a different quarter-note tempo over the same scan.
